records.label: Platform
records.line: Atelier itself, the company that runs the platform

records.label: Account
records.line: a business or a person that subscribes to Atelier: an academy with its own school, a company, a learner on Plus

records.label: Account Enterprise
records.line: a company an academy trains, under that academy

records.label: Account Consumer
records.line: an academy's own learner, in that academy's school

records.label: Merchant
records.line: a teacher's studio or an academy that sells its courses and workshops in Atelier's catalogue

records.label: Shopper
records.line: a learner who buys from every seller in the catalogue with one account
